name: How long do shingle roofs last?

mainEntity.name: How long do shingle roofs last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a shingle roof varies depending on the type of shingle, quality of installation, and local environmental factors. Standard 3-tab asphalt shingles typically last 15-20 years. Architectural or dimensional asphalt shingles, which are thicker and more durable, often last 25-30 years, with some premium options extending to 40-50 years. Proper attic ventilation and regular maintenance can also significantly impact how long your roof lasts, preventing premature aging and damage from heat buildup.
